name: Cisco DevNet MDT TIG
what_it_is: An automated Telegraf, InfluxDB, and Grafana (TIG) stack deployed via Docker, Python, and Jinja2 templates to collect and visualize Cisco Model Driven Telemetry (MDT) from network devices. It targets Cisco Catalyst and Meraki infrastructure, streaming YANG-modeled metrics over gRPC.
components: Telegraf v1.26 (MDT collector and data forwarder)
Python + Jinja2 (config file generation from config.yml template)
protocols: YANG Push (periodic and on-change streaming subscriptions)
HTTPS/REST (Meraki API and device management APIs)
measurement: Wireless client connection counts and limits
configuration: config.yml required: host IP, credentials, InfluxDB org/bucket/token, device IDs, API keys
YANG subscription paths and update policies defined per device in config.yml
Jinja2 templates auto-generate Telegraf, InfluxDB, and Grafana config files from config.yml
InfluxDB web UI accessible on port 8086; Grafana on port 3000
constraints: Requires a manually created config.yml before stack can be started
Catalyst 9300 Sustainability dashboard is a placeholder only (not functional at time of README)
No built-in TLS/encryption for telemetry transport; external Duo Network Gateway recommended for remote access
No documented scalability limits or multi-device performance guidance
docker_services: telegraf (MDT collector, listens on gRPC port 57000)
notable_absences: docker-compose.yml not found at repository root on main or master branch (may be in a subdirectory)
No fault injection or chaos testing capability
No authentication beyond basic username/password (no IAM/RBAC)
No error recovery or alerting configuration documented
Catalyst 9300 support listed as coming but not implemented
